subject: Taxes
title: Italy's Tax Evasion Culture
description: A quick, practical guide to Italy's Tax Evasion Culture.

hook.text: Italy loses €100 billion annually to tax evasion—about 27% of total tax revenue.

buildup.text: Cash-heavy businesses, small shops, and self-employed professionals underreport routinely. The practice spans centuries.

discovery.text: Historians trace Italian tax resistance to centuries of foreign rulers extracting tribute.

twist.text: Italy tried a 'tax amnesty' allowing evaders to come clean at reduced penalties.

climax.text: Tax evasion can become embedded in national identity.

punchline.text: €100 billion lost yearly. When evasion is culture, policy struggles.

quiz.question: How much does Italy lose annually to tax evasion?
